title: Full Body with Walk
author: Yasmin C.
desc: A complete full-body workout that starts with a 10-minute treadmill walk to warm up, then trains every major muscle group with machines, cables, dumbbells, and kettlebells. The lower body gets goblet squats, Smith machine squats, leg press, leg extensions, leg curls, machine hip thrusts, and kettlebell deadlifts for the quads, glutes, and hamstrings. The upper body gets chest presses, shoulder presses, tricep pushdowns, cable rows, lat pulldowns, and single-arm rows, and back extensions strengthen the lower back and posterior chain. It's a high-volume session for building strength, muscle, and endurance from head to toe.
